key_insight: Policy optimization can suppress optimal responses even while reward improves, but periodically resetting the KL reference can preserve access to the base model’s capabilities.
engineering_relevance: The theory motivates combining KL regularization with reference resets to improve the sampling and optimization efficiency of language model post-training.
method: Analyze coverage collapse in REINFORCE, including with exact gradients and fixed-reference KL regularization.
Introduce Approximate Policy Mirror Descent to approximately solve successive KL-regularized subproblems with updated references.
Prove coverage-preserving guarantees for stylized PPO, GRPO, and squared-loss algorithms using softmax linear policies over pretrained features.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical failure cases and global convergence guarantees, rather than empirical benchmark results.
watch_item: The guarantees apply to softmax linear policies over pretrained features and stylized algorithms; they do not establish equivalent behavior for full neural-network post-training.
paper_title: A Theory of Policy Optimization in Post-Training: Coverage Collapse and Reference Resets
